- Shows as `{count}+ {percentage}%` when there is activity (e.g., "108+ 99%", "28+ 3%", "2+ 100%")

## Interactions & Behaviors

- **Clicking automation name link** → Navigates to the automation's edit/detail page at `/automations/v2/edit/{id}` [INFERRED from URL bar showing edit/110]
- **Toggle click** → Immediately enables or disables the automation inline (no confirmation dialog for non-critical automations; may have a confirmation for enabling ones with many subscribers) [INFERRED]
- **"+ Create Automation" button click** → Opens a new automation builder UI (likely a step-by-step wizard or a named-automation form) [INFERRED]
- **"Library" button click** → Opens a modal or panel showing pre-built automation templates from FUB's official library, from which user can clone/install [INFERRED]
- **"Create Folder" link click** → Inline or modal prompt to name a new folder [INFERRED]
- **Folder card click** ("My Automations") → Filters the table to show only automations inside that folder [INFERRED]
- **"..." (Actions) click** → Opens a contextual dropdown menu per row; likely contains: Edit, Duplicate/Clone, Delete, Move to Folder, and possibly Enable/Disable as an alternative to the toggle [INFERRED]
- **"Using: 1 ▾" chip click** → Expands a dropdown listing the specific automation(s) that reference this automation, possibly as clickable links [INFERRED]
- **Blue numbers in Started/Completed columns** → Click opens a filtered contact list showing the contacts in that state for that specific automation [INFERRED]
- **Column header "Created On ↕" click** → Toggles sort direction between ascending/descending [INFERRED]; current state appears to be descending
- **Automation name hover** → Shows full untruncated name in a black tooltip (confirmed by visible tooltip in screenshot: "Buyer LP Nurture — audience:buyer [DRAFT - DO NOT ENABLE]")
- **"ⓘ" icon in Engaged column header hover** → Shows tooltip explaining what "Engaged" means (likely: contacts currently progressing through the automation steps) [INFERRED]
- **Search field** → Filters the visible automation list client-side or server-side by name as user types [INFERRED]
- **"Admin Overview" link (top right of sub-nav)** → Opens a contextual admin onboarding/guide panel [INFERRED]
- **"?" floating help button** → Opens FUB's in-app help chat or documentation widget [INFERRED]

## Data Model Signals

### Entities

**Automation**
- `id` (integer, e.g., 110)
- `name` (string, can be long/include audience segments and draft flags)
- `steps_count` (integer)
- `started_count` (integer — contacts who have entered the automation)
- `engaged_count` (integer — contacts actively in progress, shown with "+" notation)
- `engaged_percentage` (float — percentage of started who are engaged)
- `completed_count` (integer — contacts who finished all steps)
- `status` (boolean/enum: enabled/disabled)
- `created_by_user_id` (foreign key; null for system automations)
- `created_by_system` (boolean — true for "Follow Up Boss" built-in automations)
- `created_at` (datetime, displayed as M/D/YYYY)
- `folder_id` (nullable foreign key to AutomationFolder)

**AutomationFolder**
- `id`
- `name` (e.g., "My Automations")
- `automations_count` (integer, e.g., 6)

**LinkedAutomation** (join / reference table)
- `parent_automation_id`
- `child_automation_id`
- `link_count` (shown as "Using: N")

**User** (Created By)
- `id`
- `name` (e.g., "Matt Ryan", "Follow Up Boss")
- `avatar_url` (photo for real users)
- `is_system` (boolean — true for the "Follow Up Boss" system creator)
- `initials` (e.g., "FU" for system)

### Enum Values Observed
- Automation status: `enabled` (green toggle ON), `disabled` (gray toggle OFF)
- Creator type: user (photo avatar), system (FU text avatar)
- Linked automation relation: `None`, `Using: N`

### Relationships
- Automation belongs to zero or one AutomationFolder
- Automation can link to (use) other Automations (many-to-many via LinkedAutomation)
- Automation was created by a User or by the System
- Automation has many AutomationEnrollments (the contacts who have Started/are Engaged/have Completed it)

## Rebuild Notes

### Component Breakdown

```jsx
<AdminShell>
  <PrimaryNavBar activeItem="admin" user={mattRyan} notificationCount={N} />
  <AdminSubNav activeTab="automations" />
  
  <AutomationsPage>
    <PageHeader>
      <H1>Automations</H1>
      <SearchInput placeholder="Search..." />
      <LibraryButton icon={BookIcon}>Library</LibraryButton>
      <CreateAutomationButton icon={PlusIcon} variant="filled-teal">
        + Create Automation
      </CreateAutomationButton>
    </PageHeader>

    <FolderSection>
      <SectionLabel count={1}>1 Folder</SectionLabel>
      <CreateFolderLink>Create Folder</CreateFolderLink>
      <FolderGrid>
        <FolderCard
          icon={FolderIcon}
          name="My Automations"
          count={6}
          onClick={filterByFolder}
        />
      </FolderGrid>
    </FolderSection>

    <AutomationsTable totalCount={38}>
      <TableHeader>
        <Col field="name">Name</Col>
        <Col field="linked_automations">Linked Automations</Col>
        <Col field="steps">Steps</Col>
        <Col field="started">Started</Col>
        <Col field="engaged" hasInfoTooltip>Engaged</Col>
        <Col field="completed">Completed</Col>
        <Col field="created_by">Created By</Col>
        <Col field="status">Status</Col>
        <Col field="created_on" sortable sortDirection="desc">Created On</Col>
        <Col field="actions">Actions</Col>
      </TableHeader>
      
      {automations.map(automation => (
        <AutomationRow key={automation.id}>
          <NameCell>
            <TruncatedLink
              href={`/automations/v2/edit/${automation.id}`}
              tooltip={automation.name} // full name on hover
            >
              {automation.name}
            </TruncatedLink>
          </NameCell>
          
          <LinkedAutomationsCell>
            {automation.linkedCount === 0
              ? <NoneLabel>None</NoneLabel>
              : <LinkedBadge count={automation.linkedCount} />
              // renders "Using: N ▾" with dropdown
            }
          </LinkedAutomationsCell>
          
          <StepsCell>{automation.stepsCount}</StepsCell>
          
          <StartedCell>
            {automation.startedCount > 0
              ? <ClickableCount onClick={openStartedContacts}>{automation.startedCount}</ClickableCount>
              : <span>0</span>
            }
          </StartedCell>
          
          <EngagedCell>
            {automation.engagedCount > 0
              ? `${automation.engagedCount}+ ${automation.engagedPct}%`
              : `${automation.engagedPct}%`
            }
          </EngagedCell>
          
          <CompletedCell>
            {automation.completedCount > 0
              ? <ClickableCount onClick={openCompletedContacts}>{automation.completedCount}</ClickableCount>
              : <span>0</span>
            }
          </CompletedCell>
          
          <CreatedByCell>
            <UserAvatar
              src={automation.creator.avatarUrl}
              initials={automation.creator.initials}
              isSystem={automation.creator.isSystem}
            />
            <TruncatedName>{automation.creator.name}</TruncatedName>
          </CreatedByCell>
          
          <StatusCell>
            <ToggleSwitch
              checked={automation.enabled}
              onChange={() => toggleAutomation(automation.id)}
            />
          </StatusCell>
          
          <CreatedOnCell>
            {formatDate(automation.createdAt)} // M/D/YYYY
          </CreatedOnCell>
          
          <ActionsCell>
            <KebabMenu>
              <MenuItem>Edit</MenuItem>
              <MenuItem>Duplicate</MenuItem>
              <MenuItem>Move to Folder</MenuItem>
              <MenuItem danger>Delete</MenuItem>
            </KebabMenu>
          </ActionsCell>
        </AutomationRow>
      ))}
    </AutomationsTable>
  </AutomationsPage>
  
  <FloatingHelpButton />
</AdminShell>
```

### Non-obvious Logic

1. **Name truncation + tooltip:** Automation names are truncated with ellipsis to fit the column width. On hover, a solid black tooltip renders the full name. The "[DRAFT - DO NOT ENABLE]" suffix in the first automation's name is a convention Matt uses in the name string itself — it is not a separate status field.

2. **"Engaged" notation with "+":** The "+" after the count (e.g., "108+") appears to indicate that the count is potentially a floor value, either due to display rounding or because the stat is "at least" this many. The percentage alongside represents the fraction of Started contacts who have progressed (not the fraction who completed). These are two separate metrics shown together in one cell, separated by a space.

3. **"Using: N ▾" linked automations chip:** This indicates that N other automations reference this automation as a linked action (e.g., a "trigger another automation" step). Clicking the chip shows which automations are doing the linking. Automations showing "None" are standalone and not referenced by others.

4. **System vs. user automations (Created By):** FUB pre-loads certain default automations (Unsubscribed, Open House Follow Up/Leads, Nurture Long Term Buyers, etc.) created by "Follow Up Boss" as a system entity. These are rendered with a distinctive "FU" text avatar in a dark teal circle. These can be toggled on/off and edited by the account admin, even though created by the system.

5. **Created On sort:** The sort arrow ↕ on "Created On" means the column is sortable. The current display order (5/29/2026 at top, older dates below) indicates descending sort. Clicking once ascending, clicking again descending [INFERRED].

6. **Status toggle inline API call:** Toggling ON/OFF the automation status likely fires a PATCH request to the FUB API to update the automation's enabled state, with an optimistic UI update [INFERRED].

7. **URL pattern for editing:** `/automations/v2/edit/{id}` — the `v2` in the list URL and the edit URL suggests there is a v2 of the automations engine (likely the newer version with more capabilities than the original v1 automations).

8. **"38 Automations" count vs "1 Folder with 6":** The 38 count is the total across all automations (both in folders and not in folders). The folder contains 6, meaning 32 are not in any folder (or not in visible folders).

9. **Automations with both Started=0 and Completed>0:** The "Ryan Realty - Expired Spring Strategy" row shows Started=0 but Completed=1 (blue link). This could mean that the 1 completed contact was enrolled before a reset of the Started counter, or "Started" shows currently active/in-progress enrollments only, not historical total starts. The "Completed" column appears to be a cumulative historical count.

10. **Page pagination:** With 38 automations and only ~14 visible in the viewport, the table must be either virtualized or paginated/scrollable. No pagination controls are visible, suggesting infinite scroll or full-list render with vertical scroll [INFERRED].
